speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Fish. Threepence. And do not tell me it is a feast because someone has put pepper on it. Pepper is not a dispensation. Sit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence is the breakfast. The loaf is a penny and a finger short. I am not building a week out of one fish, and I am not asking the fish to mean more than a meal.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the finger the fast, sir, or was the finger already there before the church made us holy?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The finger was already there. The fast is the fish. Mark me. Do not let him make one mystery out of two facts. He does that when the board is dull, and the board is not dull. It is fish.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two facts. I can honour two facts. I have two houses on a page upstairs, and they are alike, and that is as much mystery as this morning is going to get.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alike is no plot. Two houses the same is a street with extra chairs. Who wants what? If you cannot say, you have not got a story. You have got a mirror, and a mirror is a poor guest at breakfast.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not saying who wants what. Not over fish, and not today. The page stops before anyone speaks. So do I. You may have the likeness. You may not have the quarrel.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: If they are alike, which one do I pity? I have to put the pity somewhere, or it sits on the table with the pepper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You pity neither. You eat. Pity is a second breakfast, and I am not serving one. There is no speech for you to carry downstairs afterwards and get wrong, which should be a relief to the water-carriers.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. I will not have a telling at my board. I have had the forsworn gentlemen, and I have said what I think of them, and I am not opening a new ruling for houses I have not been given. Threepence covers the fish. It does not cover a performance.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You will not be given them. Anne's sheet is in the chest. I am not opening that either. The letter that went has gone. There is not a new one this morning. The chest stays shut, and the fish does not require it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I did not ask for your wife's letter. I asked for a plot, and you have refused, which is at least a whole sentence. Eat while it is hot. If you will not eat it hot, I cannot promise to keep it patient.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: May I know the name of one house? One name is not a plot. A name is how a person starts. I am not asking for the end.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not even a name. Names said aloud are a walk, and this is a kitchen. If I say them here I shall start to hear them answer, and they are not to answer yet. Eat the fish. Leave the page upstairs.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then keep them shut. Alike, and no plot, and threepence, and the chest unopened. I can remember four things. I do not need a fifth, and I do not need a name to make the four feel thin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four is enough. The King comes before these houses. I have written that on the page, and I am not explaining the King over breakfast. He is not begun. Saying he comes first is not the same as having him.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the King the laughing play? That was pancakes. The curses were the next morning. Yesterday was the book from Paul's. I am trying to keep the days in a row, sir, since nobody else will say them in order.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Yesterday was the book. The King is not that book, and he is not the play we have just stopped. Field has a chronicle. I have not got it. I am not sending you for it, Alse, and I am not going for it myself today.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I should hope not. Chronicles are heavy, and Alse has the fish to clear, which is learning enough for a maid on a Friday. Wipe when you are done. A great clearing can wait until there is a Saturday worth of mess. I have looked at your desk. It is not there yet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Saturday can have the mess, if Saturday wants it. Today has the fish and the blank. I am not filling the blank to please a breakfast, and I am not striking anything, because there is nothing yet written in a list to strike.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the blank is yours and the threepence is mine. As I am a Christian woman, alike is still no plot. I shall say it once more, so it does not grow a speech on the stair while I am carrying the plates.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will clear the fish. I will not clear the page. I cannot read it, and I am glad, because then I cannot be stopped on the stair and asked what it means.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You are safe. There is no speech on it to mean. If anyone asks what I bought, say a book from Paul's, sixpence, short a leaf. That is the truth that has a price. The rest has not got one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sixpence yesterday, threepence today. I like a morning that does not swell. Do not sit here until the fish becomes a lesson. Lessons are Master Thwaite's, and he is not in my kitchen, which is one of the kitchen's virtues.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am getting up. The page can stay as it is. The chest can stay shut. You have the threepence. I have the blank. That is a fair split for a Friday, and I am not improving the split.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then take the blank upstairs. The threepence stays here. I have had my four things, and the fifth can wait for a day with a list.
